summary.name: LINQPad
summary.one_liner: LINQPad is a .NET scratchpad for interactively running C# code, LINQ and SQL queries, and exploring databases.
use_cases: Interactively explore and query databases using LINQ or SQL
Prototype and test C# and .NET code snippets
Automate build and cloud management scripts
summary.what_it_does: LINQPad lets you write and run LINQ or SQL queries against databases, with association properties generated from foreign keys so related rows can be expanded by clicking. Its Dump method renders a wide range of objects, including charts, images, and WPF or Windows Forms controls. Util.Cache stores intermediate results so scripts can be re-run without recomputing them. It supports C# features such as async/await and unsafe code, #load for importing scripts, and a lightweight debugger. Built-in tools include a BenchmarkDotNet-based benchmark visualizer, a RegEx evaluator, and an Excel export engine.
notable: Automatic association properties from foreign keys for walking a database by clicking
Built-in BenchmarkDotNet benchmarking with a real-time visualizer
Optional AI features (completion, chat, SQL-to-LINQ, coding agent) in the Premium edition
caveats: Advanced AI features require the paid Premium edition
SQL autocompletion is listed only for SQL Server, SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL
